functions.name: append_admin_action
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.append_admin_action()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r jsonb;
begin
  r := case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end;
  insert into public.tenant_admin_actions(tenant_id,action,target_user_id,content_key,created_by)
  values (coalesce((r->>'tenant_id')::uuid,(r->>'id')::uuid),
    tg_table_name || '.' || lower(tg_op), (r->>'user_id')::uuid,r->>'content_key',auth.uid());
  return null;
end $function$

functions.name: set_admin_permissions
functions.arguments: p_tenant_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_can_approve_users boolean, p_can_create_admin boolean, p_can_modify_content boolean
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_admin_permissions(p_tenant_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_can_approve_users boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_can_create_admin boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_can_modify_content boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform app_private.lock_tenant(p_tenant_id,true,true);
  update public.tenant_staff_assignments set
    can_approve_users = coalesce(p_can_approve_users,can_approve_users),
    can_create_admin = coalesce(p_can_create_admin,can_create_admin),
    can_modify_content = coalesce(p_can_modify_content,can_modify_content)
    where tenant_id = p_tenant_id and user_id = p_user_id and role = 'admin' and status = 'active';
  if not found then raise exception 'active_admin_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_auto_approve_users(p_tenant_id uuid, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform app_private.lock_tenant(p_tenant_id,true,true);
  update public.tenant_settings set auto_approve_users = p_enabled where tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
end $function$

functions.name: set_tenant_archived
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_tenant_archived(p_tenant_id uuid, p_archived boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform app_private.lock_tenant(p_tenant_id,true,true);
  if p_archived is null then raise exception 'archive_flag_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  update public.tenants set operational_status = case when p_archived then 'archived' else 'active' end
    where id = p_tenant_id and operational_status <> case when p_archived then 'archived' else 'active' end;
end $function$

relations.name: my_community_summaries
relations.definition:
SELECT t.id,
    t.name,
    t.city,
    t.state_province,
    t.country_code,
    t.operational_status,
    t.created_at,
    COALESCE(s.status = 'active'::text AND s.role = 'owner'::text, false) AS is_owned,
    COALESCE(s.status = 'active'::text, false) AS is_managed,
    COALESCE(c.standing = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'suspended'::text]), false) AS is_member
   FROM tenants t
     CROSS JOIN ( SELECT app_private.verified_user() AS user_id) actor
     LEFT JOIN community_accounts c ON c.tenant_id = t.id AND c.user_id = actor.user_id
     LEFT JOIN tenant_staff_assignments s ON s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.user_id = actor.user_id
  WHERE actor.user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.standing IS DISTINCT FROM 'removed'::text AND (s.status = 'active'::text OR (c.standing = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'suspended'::text])));

relations.name: tenant_admin_candidates
relations.definition:
SELECT c.tenant_id,
    c.user_id,
    c.standing,
    s.status AS staff_status,
    s.role AS staff_role,
    p.display_name
   FROM community_accounts c
     JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
     JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = c.user_id
     LEFT JOIN tenant_staff_assignments s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.user_id = c.user_id
     LEFT JOIN community_account_profiles p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id
  WHERE t.operational_status = 'active'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM tenant_staff_assignments actor
          WHERE actor.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND actor.user_id = (( SELECT app_private.verified_user() AS verified_user)) AND actor.status = 'active'::text AND actor.can_create_admin)) AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.email IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(u.is_anonymous, false) AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until <= now())
  ORDER BY c.user_id;

relations.name: tenant_pending_community_accounts
relations.definition:
SELECT c.tenant_id,
    c.user_id,
    p.display_name
   FROM community_accounts c
     JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
     LEFT JOIN community_account_profiles p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id
  WHERE t.operational_status = 'active'::text AND c.standing = 'pending'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM tenant_staff_assignments actor
          WHERE actor.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND actor.user_id = (( SELECT app_private.verified_user() AS verified_user)) AND actor.status = 'active'::text AND actor.can_approve_users))
  ORDER BY c.created_at, c.user_id;

constraints.name: tenant_website_content_overrides_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (char_length(btrim(text_value)) > 0 AND char_length(text_value) <=
CASE
    WHEN content_key ~~ '%.eyebrow'::text THEN 120
    WHEN content_key ~~ '%.heading'::text THEN 200
    WHEN content_key ~~ '%.body'::text THEN 2000
    ELSE 500
END)

constraints.name: tenant_website_content_overrides_content_key_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (content_key = ANY (ARRAY['community.hero.eyebrow'::text, 'community.hero.heading'::text, 'community.hero.description'::text, 'community.welcome.eyebrow'::text, 'community.welcome.heading'::text, 'community.welcome.body'::text, 'community.welcome.emphasis'::text]))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES user_accounts(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: tenant_website_content_overrides_pkey

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES user_accounts(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: CHECK (char_length(slug) >= 3 AND char_length(slug) <= 63 AND slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'::text AND (slug <> ALL (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'api'::text, 'app'::text, 'auth'::text, 'account'::text, 'accounts'::text, 'callback'::text, 'community'::text, 'communities'::text, 'create'::text, 'dashboard'::text, 'discover'::text, 'help'::text, 'home'::text, 'login'::text, 'logout'::text, 'new'::text, 'privacy'::text, 'profile'::text, 'reset-password'::text, 'settings'::text, 'signup'::text, 'support'::text, 'terms'::text, 'www'::text])))
